working_definition: Adult VNC cells of the authors' type hemilineage 16B (Allen et al. 2020, Figure 1-source data 2), 5-day-old adults.

best_match.fbbt_definition: Any neuron that develops from neuroblast NB1-1 during the postembryonic phase of neurogenesis. These are all Notch OFF hemilineage neurons, as the Notch ON hemilineage is eliminated by apoptosis (Lacin et al., 2019). In the adult, these neurons are glutamatergic (Lacin et al., 2019).

justification: The authors' predicted hemilineage 16B (Figure 4). FBbt has no hemilineage 16B term; lineage 16's secondary neurons are its parent (the authors predict no 16A cells). Also the authors' neurotransmitter for this cluster (glutamate): adult glutamatergic neuron (additional match).
recommendation: Map to FBbt:00048896 lineage 16 secondary neuron (broad match).

additional_matches.fbbt_definition: Any glutamatergic neuron of the adult.
